appearances.title: ISTA-DASLab ships DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 GSQ-RCO Coder, a 763B model pruned and quantized for coding
appearances.summary: GGUF release from ISTA-DASLab combining GSQ quantization and RCO expert pruning on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, tuned for coding and agent work, runnable with Strata. The model card puts files at about 182.7 GB (72.1 GB transformer plus 110.6 GB Engram tables that can stay on disk), retained weights averaging 2.06 bits, and SWE-bench Verified at 77.0 versus 81.2 for the base. Flagged on X: The '1 bit
appearances.doubt: The '1 bit per weight' headline counts 192 of 384 pruned experts per layer as zero bits; the card itself shows kept weights average 2.06 bits, total files near 183 GB and a 4.2 point SWE-bench Verified drop.
